electricalAngleOfInverter2Against: Electrical angle of inverter 2 against inverter 1 (dual 3-phase is usually 30°). It changes the DC-link ripple, not the device losses.
rmsCurrentOfOnePhaseOne: RMS current of ONE phase (one inverter leg), continuous.
fundamentalElectricalFrequencyTheCarrier: Fundamental electrical frequency. The carrier is rounded to a whole number of periods of it (synchronous modulation).
displacementPowerFactorOfTheLoad: Displacement power factor of the load. Sets the power (and the efficiency), not the device losses.
thePowerDeviceFromTheCatalogue: The power device, from the catalogue below. Its card carries the datasheet numbers this solve uses.
dual3PhaseTheXY: Dual 3-phase: the x-y plane links no air-gap flux, only leakage limits its current. Required for two inverters — no field solve here measures it.
carrierPhaseShiftOfInverter2: Carrier phase shift of inverter 2 against inverter 1, 0–180° of a carrier period. Trades alpha-beta ripple against x-y ripple.
optionalPhaseCurrentThdPwmRipple: Optional: phase-current THD (PWM ripple / fundamental) above this is flagged FAIL.
howTheBridgesAreCombinedWith: How the bridges are combined with the motor: one inverter, two inverters on alternate coils, an H-bridge per coil, or an explicit coil-to-bridge mapping.
unipolarSwitchesTheTwoLegsAgainst: Unipolar switches the two legs against opposite references — the coil sees twice the ripple frequency and half the step. Bipolar switches the diagonals together.
gateOffVoltage0VOr: Gate-off voltage: 0 V or −5 V. It changes both the turn-off energy and the body-diode drop during dead time.
bothSwitchesOfALegOff: Both switches of a leg off. The current then runs through a SiC body diode at ~4 V, so this is expensive — and it is what distorts the output voltage at every current zero crossing.
liquidColdplateForcedAirFanSlipstream: Liquid coldplate, forced air (fan/slipstream) or still air (no fan) — the same three the thermal simulation offers for the housing, now for the device heatsink/plate.
howManyPlatesUsuallyOnePer: How many plates (usually one per module) the flow is split over or runs through. At least 2.
aHeatsinkBoltedToEachDevice: A heatsink bolted to EACH device, or one PCB pad shared by every device on it.
everyPublishedLimitOfTheChosen: Every published limit of the chosen device with the number this duty reaches. A line that is not judged is one the datasheet does not publish or this model does not compute — never a pass by omission.
whatTheCoilActuallySeesThe: What the coil actually sees: the PWM terminal voltage with the device drops and the dead-time windows, over the phase current. The voltage error the dead time causes flips sign at every current zero crossing.
everyBlockNeedsASourceLine: Every block needs a source line naming the table or figure it was transcribed from. A value the datasheet does not publish stays out — the loss model says so rather than guessing.

emTiles.sleeveLossTip: Eddy loss in the carbon-fibre retaining ring. Milliwatts on purpose: a hoop-wound sleeve conducts very little across its fibres.
emTiles.noBearings: No bearings on this machine, so this loss is unknown, not zero. Assign them in Mechanical → Shaft & bearings and it fills in.
emTiles.bearingsTip: Bearing friction, {cards}, by the SKF frictional-moment model at {temp} °C (analytic, not the field solve). Part of Total loss.
emTiles.windageTip: Air drag on the rotor: gap friction {gap} W + the two end faces {faces} W (analytic, not the field solve). Part of Total loss.
emTiles.eddyUnsettled: The eddy warm-up ended before the start-up transient settled, so this number is over-read.
emTiles.notSolved: Not solved on this run: rotor eddy was off, so magnet and shaft eddy losses are missing and the efficiency is optimistic.
emTiles.magnetSeg: The magnets are sliced axially ({slice} mm slices of a {stack} mm stack, loop width {width} mm): the 2-D eddy loss is multiplied by {factor}. A model, and a lower bracket.
emTiles.ironBertotti: Bertotti loss in stator and rotor steel, fitted to the material's measured curves; alternating-axis basis, manufacturing degradation not included.
emTiles.ironMeasured: From the manufacturer's measured P(B, f) table, interpolated directly; alternating-axis basis, manufacturing degradation not included.
emTiles.wallToShaftTip: Inverter efficiency × shaft efficiency: the power stage on top of the machine's own shaft efficiency. A different quantity from the Efficiency tile.
emTiles.iWindingTip: Delta: the current in ONE winding = the line current ÷ √3. It is what the field was driven with and what the current density is billed on.
emTiles.turnsCoilTip: Series turns per coil. Wound {hand} wires in hand with {strips} strips in series per row; the phase current splits over {paths} conductors.
emTiles.bGapMeanTip: Mean |B| over the air-gap clearance, averaged over the electrical period: the whole gap under load, magnet flux and armature reaction together.
emTiles.lxyTip: Six-phase: the inductance between the two sets driven against each other (circulating x-y current). It alone limits PWM current flowing from one inverter into the other.
emTiles.perSetTip: Six-phase: each of the two in-phase sets carries half the phase current at the full phase voltage (fundamental peak).
emTiles.rotorInertiaTip: Rotor moment of inertia about the shaft axis, from the same CAD sections as the mass. Drive sizing: t_accel = J·Δω/T.
emTiles.brCornerTip: Worst single magnet element: a corner flag, not the magnet's figure (that is Demag coef.). A sharp-corner value that does not converge with mesh refinement.
emTiles.end3dTip: Axial end-effect correction ×{k} from the 3D static solve of THIS machine: multiply the 2D flux, EMF and torque by it.
emTiles.end3dInherited: Inherited from an earlier geometry of this machine: recompute Stage A.
emTiles.demagArea: {area} % of the magnet area is de-rated.
emTiles.partTip: Part mass and its share of the active mass.
emTiles.partRefTip: Customer-supplied part: it is in the field and in the losses but not billed in the mass; shown at the mass it was modelled at.
emTiles.ironSplitStator: Stator iron {st} W: hysteresis {sh} / eddy {se} / excess {sx} W.
emTiles.ironSplitRotor: Rotor iron {rt} W: hysteresis {rh} / eddy {re} / excess {rx} W.

propLoad.tip: Every point is a steady continuous operating point of this motor driving the propeller (our propeller S1 rating: propeller load, passport torque and losses, temperatures at equilibrium). Dashed: above the continuous limit (short bursts only).
propLoad.noData: No load data for this propeller yet.
propLoad.note: Solid: continuous (S1) operation. Dashed: above the continuous limit - short bursts only.
propLoad.moved: The load chart belongs to the catalogue build of this motor: return the build settings to see it.
propLoad.toS1: Set speed to the S1 limit ({rpm} rpm)
propLoad.s1Note: Green dashed line: the continuous (S1) limit with this propeller.
propLoad.linesNote2: Green dashed: the motor's own continuous limit (temperature, demagnetisation, voltage). Orange dashed: the controller's (or ESC's, battery's) continuous current; not shown with a sine drive.
